description: Dated events between from and to (default today + 30 days): family events (every day they span), maintenance and pet care due dates, chores (recurrences expanded, with whose turn), document expiries and food expiries.

kid.description: Preset filter: only entries explicitly for this kid (their events, activities, chores, renewals)

member.description: 'My' view: that member's events + Everyone events, their chores, and a kid's activity sessions

pets.description: Preset filter: only pet-linked entries (pet care, pet renewals/documents, events assigned to a pet)
